doc:
(after both bases): results/v352/lc3_hot_bound_v352r3_gvlo_gvhi.json: for stops and cones, per part / state / set the row
     of the base with the lower MS_bound (the worse of the g3 and h3 outputs) and the check that it equals the per-base maxima of the
     bound stress: every combined row is one of the two per-base rows; per part the combined minimum = min over the bases of the per-base
     minimum (MS_bound and MS_ult_bound, summary rows likewise).  [DERIVED]
evidence: DERIVED (lc3_bound sub-additivity bound on the R3 bases; SIM inputs)
